memory: I have measured SRD 20–80% rise ≈70 ps and jitter ≈18 ps. The 3 dB pad +15 Ω damping reduces reflected spectral amplitude ≈8–12 dB; tail sits ≈−27 dB at 500 ps. SPICE with an ideal absorptive shunt predicted ≈12.4 dB tail reduction but assumed perfect grounds. I abandoned naive lumped assumptions after discovering series parasitic inductance in package/return paths ruins the absorber. Recent assembly failure (solder bridge) and TDR indicate loop inductance ≈0.6–0.9 nH. Current position: Rs-at-pad remains promising only with a dense via fence and minimized bondwire/trace inductance; PCB redesign and controlled reflow are next.
openQuestion: After adding a via-fence and controlling solder fillets, how do Rs-at-pad vs 3 mm affect 1.80 GHz notch depth and 20–80% rise? (Measure S21 0.1–6 GHz + 10k-shot.)
